objective: Compare GLM, recipe-random and canonical-form enumeration at budgets 12/24/36. The enumerator is a form-privileged reference rather than an exploration upper bound.
query: 在给定的合成研究面板上，寻找对下月收益具有真实增量预测力的横截面因子假设。

dgp.seed_policy: Development seed blocks begin at 2120 and 2220. Evaluation seeds 3000+ remain reserved.

oracle.truth_definition: abs overall Spearman correlation between candidate values and the per-month-standardized injected mechanism signal std(F_ep * sign(F_illiq))
oracle.threshold_sensitivity: For a separate sensitivity analysis, recompute true-accept counts from saved candidate truth_loading values at thresholds 0.4 and 0.6; the runner classifies truth at the primary threshold 0.5.

glm.cell_choice_note: Use narrow vocabulary, recipe prompting and hard cross-family constraints. Generation-attempt budgets are three times oracle-trial budgets; report actual attempted and completed trials.

interpretation.primary_metric: per (generator, budget): pooled per-trial true-accept rate on alternative panels, with per-seed discovery counts (k/5) reported alongside
interpretation.decision_rule: Pairwise per budget (glm vs enumerator, glm vs recipe_random, enumerator vs recipe_random): CONFIRMED for a side only when its Wilson 95% lower bound exceeds the other side's Wilson 95% upper bound; overlap reads INCONCLUSIVE; below minimum_pooled_trials reads INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
interpretation.enumerator_prediction: Narrow vocabulary has 48 ordered cross-family pairs (4 value x 6 liquidity x 2 directions). If exactly one ordered pair (ep, illiq) loads >= 0.5 in canonical form, the enumerator's expected per-seed discovery is ~B/48: 0.25 / 0.50 / 0.75 at B = 12 / 24 / 36. Correlated near-columns (e.g. other value columns vs ep) may push measured above predicted -- that deviation is a REPORTED calibration of the truth-loading threshold, not an error.
interpretation.reading_guide: Compare GLM, recipe-random and enumerator curves at equal budgets. Report paired seed outcomes; pooled curves alone cannot establish superiority or explain its cause.
interpretation.null_rule: Local-control null panels run at budget 36. Wilson bounds are descriptive; GLM null panels are not evaluated by this protocol.
interpretation.clustering_caveat: Trials cluster within seeds; 5 independent alternative seeds per point.

recipe_conformance_policy: Declared recipes are host-validated and recorded. The canonical enumerator declares conditional_signal; the host verifies conformance.
execution_note: Baseline arms (enumerator, recipe_random) run locally without credentials. GLM cells require GLM_API_KEY and the project interpreter; resumable via --arms; quote the comma list in PowerShell.
